+#include "libavutil/attributes.h"
+#include "libavutil/cpu.h"
+#include "libavutil/riscv/cpu.h"
+#include "libavfilter/bwdifdsp.h"
+
+void ff_bwdif_filter_line_rvv(void *dst, const void *prev, const void *cur,
+                              const void *next, int w, int prefs, int mrefs,
+                              int prefs2, int mrefs2, int prefs3, int mrefs3,
+                              int prefs4, int mrefs4, int parity, int clip_max);
+
+void ff_bwdif_filter_edge_rvv(void *dst, const void *prev, const void *cur,
+                              const void *next, int w, int prefs, int mrefs,
+                              int prefs2, int mrefs2, int parity, int clip_max,
+                              int spat);
+
+av_cold void ff_bwdif_init_riscv(BWDIFDSPContext *s, int bit_depth)
+{
+#if HAVE_RVV
+    int flags = av_get_cpu_flags();
+
+    if (bit_depth == 8 && (flags & AV_CPU_FLAG_RVV_I32) &&
+        ff_rv_vlen_least(128)) {
+        s->filter_line = ff_bwdif_filter_line_rvv;
+        s->filter_edge = ff_bwdif_filter_edge_rvv;
+    }
+#endif
+}
diff --git a/libavfilter/riscv/vf_bwdif_rvv.S b/libavfilter/riscv/vf_bwdif_rvv.S

index 0000000000..7aceaa58c4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/libavfilter/riscv/vf_bwdif_rvv.S
@@ -0,0 +1,343 @@

+ *
+ * You should have received a copy of the GNU Lesser General Public
+ * License along with FFmpeg; if not, write to the Free Software
+ * Foundation, Inc., 51 Franklin Street, Fifth Floor, Boston, MA 02110-1301 USA
+ */
+
+#include "libavutil/riscv/asm.S"
+
+/* BWDIF 8-bit filter_line / filter_edge, vectorized over the pixel width.
+ * C reference: bwdifdsp.c (FILTER1 / SPAT_CHECK / FILTER_LINE /
+ * FILTER_EDGE / FILTER2)
+ *
+ * filter_line signature (15 args):
+ *   a0=dst a1=prev a2=cur a3=next a4=w a5=prefs a6=mrefs a7=prefs2
+ *   sp+0=mrefs2 sp+8=prefs3 sp+16=mrefs3 sp+24=prefs4 sp+32=mrefs4
+ *   sp+40=parity sp+48=clip_max
+ * filter_edge signature (12 args):
+ *   a0=dst a1=prev a2=cur a3=next a4=w a5=prefs a6=mrefs a7=prefs2
+ *   sp+0=mrefs2 sp+8=parity sp+16=clip_max sp+24=spat
+ * coef_lf = {4309, 213}, coef_hf = {5570, 3801, 1016}, coef_sp = {5077, 981}
+ * Pixel loads are unsigned 8-bit (vzext.vf2).
+ * regs: v0..v17 = loaded rows (e16); v18+ temps; v24 = interpol (e32)
+ */
+
+.macro bwdif_prologue
+        lpad    0
+        addi    sp, sp, -128
+        sd      s0, 0(sp)
+        sd      s1, 8(sp)
+        sd      s2, 16(sp)
+        sd      s3, 24(sp)
+        sd      s4, 32(sp)
+        sd      s5, 40(sp)
+        sd      s6, 48(sp)
+        sd      s7, 56(sp)
+        sd      ra, 64(sp)
+.endm
+
+.macro bwdif_epilogue
+        ld      s0, 0(sp)
+        ld      s1, 8(sp)
+        ld      s2, 16(sp)
+        ld      s3, 24(sp)
+        ld      s4, 32(sp)
+        ld      s5, 40(sp)
+        ld      s6, 48(sp)
+        ld      s7, 56(sp)
+        ld      ra, 64(sp)
+        addi    sp, sp, 128
+        ret
+.endm
+
+.macro bwdif_absdiff16 vd, vsa, vsb
+        vsub.vv        \vd, \vsa, \vsb
+        vneg.v         v28, \vd
+        vmax.vv        \vd, \vd, v28
+.endm
+
+.macro bwdif_ld8 vd, base, off
+        add     t0, \base, \off
+        vle8.v  v30, (t0)
+        vzext.vf2 \vd, v30
+.endm
+
+.macro bwdif_ld8r vd, base, roff
+        lw      t1, 128+\roff(sp)
+        add     t0, \base, t1
+        vle8.v  v30, (t0)
+        vzext.vf2 \vd, v30
+.endm
+
+/* Core FILTER1 + SPAT/FILTER + FILTER2 for one VL of pixels.
+ * Inputs (e16): v0=prev2 v1=next2 v2=prev[mrefs] v3=prev[prefs]
+ * v4=cur[mrefs] v5=cur[prefs] v6=next[mrefs] v7=next[prefs]
+ * v8=prev2[mrefs2] v9=next2[mrefs2] v10=prev2[prefs2] v11=next2[prefs2]
+ * v12=cur[mrefs3] v13=cur[prefs3] v14=prev2[mrefs4] v15=next2[mrefs4]
+ * v16=prev2[prefs4] v17=next2[prefs4]
+ * is_edge: 1 -> interpol=(c+e)>>1, SPAT only when t3(spat)!=0;
+ *          0 -> FILTER_LINE (SPAT always)
+ * clip_max in t2 (saved), d in v20, nz mask in v25, out in v24(e16)
+ */
+.macro bwdif_core is_edge
+        vsetvli zero, s2, e16, m2, ta, ma
+        /* d = (prev2 + next2) >> 1 */
+        vadd.vv v20, v0, v1
+        vsrl.vi v20, v20, 1
+        /* tdiff0 = |prev2 - next2| */
+        bwdif_absdiff16 v18, v0, v1
+        /* tdiff1 = (|prev[mrefs]-c| + |prev[prefs]-e|)>>1 */
+        bwdif_absdiff16 v19, v2, v4
+        bwdif_absdiff16 v21, v3, v5
+        vadd.vv v19, v19, v21
+        vsrl.vi v19, v19, 1
+        /* tdiff2 */
+        bwdif_absdiff16 v21, v6, v4
+        bwdif_absdiff16 v23, v7, v5
+        vadd.vv v21, v21, v23
+        vsrl.vi v21, v21, 1
+        /* diff = max(tdiff0>>1, tdiff1, tdiff2) */
+        vsrl.vi v22, v18, 1
+        vmax.vv v22, v22, v19
+        vmax.vv v22, v22, v21
+        /* nz = diff != 0 */
+        vmsne.vx v25, v22, zero
+.if \is_edge
+        beqz    t3, 10f          /* spat==0: skip SPAT_CHECK */
+.endif
+        /* SPAT_CHECK: b,f,dc,de ; diff = max3(diff,min,-max) */
+        vadd.vv v19, v8, v9
+        vsrl.vi v19, v19, 1
+        vsub.vv v19, v19, v4       /* b */
+        vadd.vv v21, v10, v11
+        vsrl.vi v21, v21, 1
+        vsub.vv v21, v21, v5       /* f */
+        vsub.vv v23, v20, v4       /* dc */
+        vsub.vv v26, v20, v5       /* de */
+        vmin.vv v27, v19, v21      /* min(b,f) */
+        vmax.vv v19, v19, v21      /* max(b,f) */
+        vmax.vv v27, v27, v26      /* max(min(b,f), de) */
+        vmax.vv v27, v27, v23      /* max = MAX3(de,dc,min) */
+        vmin.vv v19, v19, v26      /* min(max(b,f), de) */
+        vmin.vv v19, v19, v23      /* min = MIN3(de,dc,max) */
+        vneg.v v26, v27            /* -max */
+        vmax.vv v22, v22, v19      /* diff = max3(diff, min, -max) */
+        vmax.vv v22, v22, v26
+.if \is_edge
+10:
+        /* interpol = (c + e) >> 1 */
+        vadd.vv v24, v4, v5
+        vsrl.vi v24, v24, 1
+.else
+        /* ce = |c - e| (e16); HF selected when tdiff0 < ce */
+        bwdif_absdiff16 v19, v4, v5
+        /* p2+n2 = prev2[0]+next2[0] (consumes v0/v1 -> v21) */
+        vadd.vv v21, v0, v1
+        /* HF mask in v0 (e16, same vl as e32 later): tdiff0 < ce */
+        vmslt.vv v0, v18, v19
+        /* m2 = p2m2+n2m2+p2p2+n2p2 ; m4 = m4sum+p4sum */
+        vadd.vv v23, v8, v9
+        vadd.vv v28, v10, v11
+        vadd.vv v23, v23, v28      /* m2 */
+        vadd.vv v28, v14, v15
+        vadd.vv v29, v16, v17
+        vadd.vv v28, v28, v29      /* m4 */
+        vadd.vv v29, v4, v5        /* c+e */
+        vadd.vv v30, v12, v13      /* cm3+cp3 */
+        /* widen to e32 and combine:
+         * HF: ((5570*(p2+n2) - 3801*m2 + 1016*m4) >> 2
+         *     + 4309*(c+e) - 213*(cm3+cp3)) >> 13
+         * SP: (5077*(c+e) - 981*(cm3+cp3)) >> 13 */
+        vsetvli zero, s2, e32, m4, ta, ma
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v4, v21       /* p2+n2 */
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v8, v23       /* m2 */
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v12, v28      /* m4 */
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v16, v29      /* c+e */
+        vwcvt.x.x.v v28, v30      /* cm3+cp3 */
+        li      t5, 5570
+        vmul.vx v4, v4, t5
+        li      t5, 3801
+        vmul.vx v8, v8, t5
+        vsub.vv v4, v4, v8
+        li      t5, 1016
+        vmul.vx v12, v12, t5
+        vadd.vv v4, v4, v12
+        vsra.vi v4, v4, 2
+        li      t5, 4309
+        vmul.vx v8, v16, t5
+        vadd.vv v4, v4, v8
+        li      t5, 213
+        vmul.vx v8, v28, t5
+        vsub.vv v4, v4, v8
+        vsra.vi v4, v4, 13        /* v4 = hf */
+        li      t5, 5077
+        vmul.vx v8, v16, t5
+        li      t5, 981
+        vmul.vx v12, v28, t5
+        vsub.vv v8, v8, v12
+        vsra.vi v8, v8, 13        /* v8 = sp */
+        /* interpol = mask ? hf : sp  (v0 mask; sim/vf_blend convention:
+         * vmerge.vvm vd, vs2, vs1, v0 -> vd = mask ? vs1 : vs2) */
+        vmerge.vvm v24, v8, v4, v0
+        vnsrl.wi        v24, v24, 0
+        vsetvli zero, s2, e16, m2, ta, ma
+.endif
+        /* FILTER2: interpol = clip(interpol, d-diff, d+diff) */
+        vsub.vv v18, v20, v22
+        vadd.vv v26, v20, v22
+        vmax.vv v24, v24, v18
+        vmin.vv v24, v24, v26
+        /* clip [0, clip_max] ; t2 holds clip_max */
+        vmax.vx v24, v24, zero
+        vmin.vx v24, v24, t2
+        /* dst = nz ? interpol : d */
+        vxor.vv v18, v24, v20
+        vand.vv v18, v18, v25
+        vxor.vv v24, v20, v18
+        vsetvli zero, s2, e8, m1, ta, ma
+.endm
+
+/* filter_line: process w pixels, loop over VL */
+func ff_bwdif_filter_line_rvv, zve32x
+        bwdif_prologue
+        lw      t2, 176(sp)             /* clip_max */
+        mv      s3, a4                  /* w */
+        mv      s4, a5                  /* prefs */
+        mv      s5, a6                  /* mrefs */
+        mv      s6, a7                  /* prefs2 */
+        lw      t1, 168(sp)             /* parity */
+        bnez    t1, 1f
+        mv      s0, a2                  /* parity==0: prev2 = cur */
+        mv      s7, a3                  /* next2 = next */
+        j       2f
+1:
+        mv      s0, a1                  /* parity!=0: prev2 = prev */
+        mv      s7, a2                  /* next2 = cur */
+2:
+        mv      t1, s3
+3:
+        beqz    t1, 9f
+        vsetvli t6, t1, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        mv      s2, t6
+        /* load 18 rows */
+        bwdif_ld8  v0, s0, zero         /* prev2[0] */
+        bwdif_ld8  v1, s7, zero         /* next2[0] */
+        mv      t1, a6                  /* mrefs */
+        bwdif_ld8  v2, a1, t1           /* prev[mrefs] */
+        mv      t1, a5
+        bwdif_ld8  v3, a1, t1           /* prev[prefs] */
+        mv      t1, a6
+        bwdif_ld8  v4, a2, t1           /* cur[mrefs] */
+        mv      t1, a5
+        bwdif_ld8  v5, a2, t1           /* cur[prefs] */
+        mv      t1, a6
+        bwdif_ld8  v6, a3, t1           /* next[mrefs] */
+        mv      t1, a5
+        bwdif_ld8  v7, a3, t1           /* next[prefs] */
+        bwdif_ld8r v8, s0, 0        /* prev2[mrefs2] */
+        bwdif_ld8r v9, s7, 0        /* next2[mrefs2] */
+        bwdif_ld8  v10, s0, a7       /* prev2[prefs2] */
+        bwdif_ld8  v11, s7, a7       /* next2[prefs2] */
+        bwdif_ld8r v12, a2, 16      /* cur[mrefs3] */
+        bwdif_ld8r v13, a2, 8       /* cur[prefs3] */
+        bwdif_ld8r v14, s0, 32      /* prev2[mrefs4] -- WAIT mrefs4 at 32 */
+        bwdif_ld8r v15, s7, 32      /* next2[mrefs4] */
+        bwdif_ld8r v16, s0, 24      /* prev2[prefs4] -- prefs4 at 40? no, offsets: 0 mrefs2 8 prefs3 16 mrefs3 24 prefs4 32 mrefs4 40 parity 48 clip */
+        bwdif_ld8r v17, s7, 24      /* next2[prefs4] */
+        bwdif_core 0
+        /* store v24 as e8 (vl = s2 = pixels in this chunk) */
+        vsetvli t1, s2, e16, m2, ta, ma
+        vnsrl.wi        v24, v24, 0
+        vsetvli t1, s2, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vse8.v          v24, (a0)
+        add     a0, a0, s2
+        add     a1, a1, s2
+        add     a2, a2, s2
+        add     a3, a3, s2
+        add     s0, s0, s2
+        add     s7, s7, s2
+        sub     s3, s3, s2
+        mv      t1, s3
+        j       3b
+ 9:
+        bwdif_epilogue
+endfunc
+
+/* filter_edge: FILTER1 + (spat ? SPAT_CHECK) + interpol=(c+e)>>1 + FILTER2
+ * signature (12 args): a0=dst a1=prev a2=cur a3=next a4=w a5=prefs a6=mrefs
+ * a7=prefs2 sp+0=mrefs2 sp+8=parity sp+16=clip_max sp+24=spat
+ * (no prefs3/mrefs3/prefs4/mrefs4 for edge)
+ */
+func ff_bwdif_filter_edge_rvv, zve32x
+        bwdif_prologue
+        lw      t2, 144(sp)             /* clip_max (sp+16) */
+        lw      t3, 152(sp)             /* spat (sp+24) */
+        mv      s3, a4                  /* w */
+        mv      s4, a5                  /* prefs */
+        mv      s5, a6                  /* mrefs */
+        mv      s6, a7                  /* prefs2 */
+        lw      t1, 136(sp)             /* parity (sp+8) */
+        bnez    t1, 1f
+        mv      s0, a2                  /* parity==0: prev2 = cur */
+        mv      s7, a3                  /* next2 = next */
+        j       2f
+1:
+        mv      s0, a1                  /* parity!=0: prev2 = prev */
+        mv      s7, a2                  /* next2 = cur */
+2:
+        mv      t1, s3
+3:
+        beqz    t1, 9f
+        vsetvli t6, t1, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        mv      s2, t6
+        /* load 12 rows (no m3/m4 rows for edge) */
+        bwdif_ld8  v0, s0, zero         /* prev2[0] */
+        bwdif_ld8  v1, s7, zero         /* next2[0] */
+        mv      t1, a6                  /* mrefs */
+        bwdif_ld8  v2, a1, t1           /* prev[mrefs] */
+        mv      t1, a5
+        bwdif_ld8  v3, a1, t1           /* prev[prefs] */
+        mv      t1, a6
+        bwdif_ld8  v4, a2, t1           /* cur[mrefs] */
+        mv      t1, a5
+        bwdif_ld8  v5, a2, t1           /* cur[prefs] */
+        mv      t1, a6
+        bwdif_ld8  v6, a3, t1           /* next[mrefs] */
+        mv      t1, a5
+        bwdif_ld8  v7, a3, t1           /* next[prefs] */
+        bwdif_ld8r v8, s0, 0        /* prev2[mrefs2] */
+        bwdif_ld8r v9, s7, 0        /* next2[mrefs2] */
+        bwdif_ld8  v10, s0, a7       /* prev2[prefs2] */
+        bwdif_ld8  v11, s7, a7       /* next2[prefs2] */
+        bwdif_core 1
+        /* store v24 as e8 (vl = s2 = pixels in this chunk) */
+        vsetvli t1, s2, e16, m2, ta, ma
+        vnsrl.wi        v24, v24, 0
+        vsetvli t1, s2, e8, m1, ta, ma
+        vse8.v          v24, (a0)
+        add     a0, a0, s2
+        add     a1, a1, s2
+        add     a2, a2, s2
+        add     a3, a3, s2
+        add     s0, s0, s2
+        add     s7, s7, s2
+        sub     s3, s3, s2
+        mv      t1, s3
+        j       3b
+ 9:
+        bwdif_epilogue
+endfunc
